HMSC Research Seminar: Bowhead whales in a changing Arctic

Oregon State University Events

Speaker: Kate Stafford, Associate Professor, Marine Mammal Institute, Oregon State University Topic: Bowhead whales are the only baleen whale endemic to the Arctic. As such, they have numerous unique adaptations to living in the ice. Because of this habitat, they can be very difficult to study in below freezing temperatures and during polar night. However, novel tools, including passive acoustic monitoring, have given scientists a window into the dark icy world of the bowhead. This world is changing rapidly and declines in sea ice are changing the behavior of bowhead whales and introducing new threats and competitors into the Arctic.

It’s important to know how to prevent, recognize and respond to an overdose.” – Government of British Columbia Drop in with the Harm Reduction Team (HaRT) to learn how to identify an opioid poisoning, how to administer naloxone, and get your own free naloxone kit!
